newsitem.title: INDIA: India Crompton down 3 pct before results.
newsitem.headline: India Crompton down 3 pct before results.

text.p: Shares of electrical equipment maker Crompton Greaves fell 2.75 rupees, or 3.3 percent, on the Bombay bourse on Monday as investors sold ahead of the firm's results.
Crompton is expected to announce results for 1996/97 (April-March) later in the day and analysts said the firm's net is likely to fall sharply below market expectations.
"Net profit will be much below market expectations," said an analyst at a foreign brokerage.
He said the firm had recently released preliminary financial data which showed just a marginal rise in gross sales over the previous year.

"Operating margins have also declined and interest and depreciation costs are likely to be higher than the last year," he said, forecasting that net profit was likely to plunge to 310-350 million rupees, from 641 million in 1995/96.
Crompton shares were trading 2.15 rupees lower at 80.10 on the National Stock Exchange.
